source_normalization.actual_base: Rbar=R0/(ell), actual CA-F9 zA7,r_CA with s_CA=r_CA
source_normalization.allorder_pair_proof: IA zero7 are actual CA-F9 coordinates. Its own-plane gA(r,r) is r^3 times a unit. For IB the actual zero7 Jacobian in zA7 is a unit, so formal IFT gives a unique graph z=phi(r) with phi=-c*r^2+O(r^3). Use the actual eighth generator after its own zero7 Hadamard adjustment; its leading cubic along this graph is -15125/144*r^3, unchanged by z=O(r^2) and higher coordinate corrections. It generates(r^3) in the graph quotient. Consequently IB=(z-phi(r),r^3)=(z+c*r^2,r^3) exactly. All higher phi terms are absorbed by r^3. No all-order conclusion is inferred merely from equality of a truncated length20 quotient.

generator_action_convention: A/B source indices0..6 denote Z,W1..W6; index7 is r^3; B index0 is Z+r^2
whole_module_annihilation_proof: Each1296 source product kills the unit. Every basis vector is a monomial in the commuting coordinate actions applied to the unit, so each product kills every348 basis vector.
nilpotence_proof: All fixed block polynomials are homogeneous in weights(Z,W)=2,r=1. Normal forms preserve weight, and all standard weights are at most9. Thus all ordinary degree10 products vanish, while r^9 is a nonzero standard monomial.
